Ben D: uploading hero gif now (hero-optimize-2026.gif). sending card previews.
Legal Bot: flagged quote usage: customer quote present, need customer comms sign-off before publish.

Ben D: pinged CS. they said PM will approve by 3pm.
Priya S: preflight checklist I'll run: hidden field use_case, UTM mapping, double opt-in, form validation. posting results here.
Ethan P: small copy tweak: change 'deploys' to 'ships' in intro para. makes it less infra-y.
